\[
W = \begin{bmatrix}
  100 & 100 & 100 \\
  100 & 140 & 100 \\
  100 & 100 & 100
\end{bmatrix}, \qquad S_4 \star W = 5 \cdot 140 - 4 \cdot 100 = 300
\]

The center is 40 brighter than its neighbors. The Laplacian is 4 x 100 - 4 x 140 = -160, and subtracting it once raises the center to 300. The difference to the neighbors grows from 40 to 200, so the spot looks sharper.
